listing.name: Player Merge Disabler
listing.summary: This is designed so that the player faction file will not be merged with others. If you want a portrait pack to supply portraits to your faction, copy or rename the player.faction file in the portrait pack to playeralt.faction.
listing.aiSummary: Prevents the player faction file from merging with other mods' faction files.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98] Kon's Multi-Pack v.6.0.8 - 13th Battlegroup Player Faction

description:
This is designed so that the player faction file will not be merged with others.
If you want a portrait pack to supply portraits to your faction, copy or rename
the player.faction file in the portrait pack to playeralt.faction. This should allow
you to potentially create player factions with only the portraits you want.
descriptionHtml:
This is designed so that the player faction file will not be merged with others.
If you want a portrait pack to supply portraits to your faction, copy or rename
the player.faction file in the portrait pack to playeralt.faction. This should allow
you to potentially create player factions with only the portraits you want.
aiDescription: Stops other mods from overwriting or changing the player's faction configuration. It allows users to manually manage portraits by renaming portrait pack files to playeralt.faction.
